messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v2.14.1 -> canary 5% across regions. change window 00:30-02:00 UTC. tracking: deploy/2495000000
Maya: quick heads-up — post-deploy smoke failing in apac-1 for the synth probe. p95 latency spiked and we saw ~10% 503s on the probe path. :eyes:
Leo: can you paste logs?
Maya: paste logs below, truncated:
```
 2026-03-20T00:45:12Z probe-agent[svc-probe]: POST /healthcheck -> 422 {"error":"unexpected field 'kv_prefix'"}
 2026-03-20T00:45:12Z synth-probe: embed latency p95 1.2s -> 3.8s
 2026-03-20T00:45:13Z router: fallback to variant: model-v1
```
Leo: that error looks like a probe-agent schema/agent-shim mismatch. I suspect the new release includes synth-probe v2 expecting a different probe-agent API. apac still running older probe-agent binary.
Sam: options: rollback release entirely, or pause rollout and pin traffic for affected regions to previous model variant while we fix agent. Prefer minimal blast radius: pause to eu/apac, keep na rolling.
Alexa: we have a feature-flag to switch probe-controller -> probe-agent shim version per region. I tried flipping it for apac but the controller returned 409 (conflict).
Maya: controller 409 explains why some hosts never reconciled. The deploy made a staggered config change; older controller instances are still in the fleet. Seems like a staggered-config race.
Sam: OK let's be conservative. Proposal: 1) pause the global rollout (stop further canary increases), 2) pin routing in apac/eu to model-v1 via traffic-split, 3) create incident and page oncall, 4) bake a hotfix to probe-agent and coordinate a patch deploy. Thoughts? :thumbsup:
Leo: +1. Also add a quick synthetic: run a targeted probe against canary nodes with agent v2 to reproduce locally before broad rollout.
deploy-bot: rollout paused by Sam. Canary increments halted. Regions held: eu*, apac*.
ops-oncall-bot: created incident INC-2026-042, severity P2, assignees: Maya, Leo. Pager sent to oncall.
Alexa: I can apply traffic pin to apac now: runbook command:
```
redwoodctl traffic pin --region apac-1 --model model-v1 --until 2026-03-20T03:00:00Z
```
Maya: running the pin now... returns 200, traffic pinned. Verified synth probes for apac are back to baseline after pin. :white_check_mark:
Sam: good. We'll keep NA canary open but not increase. Maya/Leo take lead on probe-agent fix, update this thread with ETA and release note blurb. Ops, please hold change window extension request until confirm.
Maya: quick release-note draft: "hotfix scheduled: probe-agent shim mismatch caused post-deploy synth probe failures in APAC/EU. Rolling pin applied; patch to probe-agent scheduled. Change window may be extended by 30m."
Leo: I'll push a tiny patch to probe-agent (reconcile shim) and run staging smoke. ETA ~35m.
Sam: agree to hold — if staging smoke passes, we'll roll patch to agents and then resume rollout. If not, we'll rollback model release fully.
Maya: noted. Adding a short postmortem tag for follow-up. Will update INC-2026-042 with logs + timeline.
deploy-bot: note: paused rollout and pinned traffic. Please update the incident with any manual roll commands.
Sam: thanks all. We'll reconvene here once staging smoke completes. Mingling with ops to request +30m change window if needed. :calendar:
